title: Fix a multi-stage pipeline with sequential bugs (iterative)
prompt: This project has a data-processing pipeline in `pipeline.js` (parse -> normalize -> aggregate) and a test suite `pipeline.test.js`. Several stages contain bugs. The end-to-end result is only correct once every stage is fixed, so you will likely need to fix a bug, re-run `node --test`, find the next failure, and repeat until the entire suite passes. Fix `pipeline.js` only. Do NOT modify the test file.
